messages:
marta: Product wants per-promptshape breakdown of prefetch credits in the cost dashboard so PMs can see marginal token cost.
ajay: Define promptshape? I'd do small/medium/large + system_token_present boolean. Low cardinality.
kai: That works. Also we should separate hotpath reuse (1:1) from amortized prefetch.
ryan: Reproducibility is key. Use observed_invocations with Laplace smoothing and persist a seed per billing window.
beth: UI: two numbers (hotpath_reuse, amortized_prefetch) and a combined "avoided cost". Internal admin can inspect weights.
infra-bot: Heads-up: cache-credits-service will add group_by=promptshape and algorithm metadata to /v1/credits in next deploy.
ajay: API should return allocations array plus algorithm: {method, alpha, seed} for hover help.
kai: Implementation: compute allocations in streaming aggregator -> MV, avoid per-render compute.
ryan: SQL sketch: compute invocations per (billing_window, model_sku, promptshape), apply (invocations+alpha)/SUM(...) to get weight, then multiply by total_prefetch_tokens.
beth: Add model_sku normalization so tokens map to cents correctly across mixed chains.
marta: Action items: infra adds metadata to API (kai), aggregator MV (ryan), console toggle for experimental vs legacy (beth).
ajay: Default alpha=0.25, expose only in admin docs.
kai: I'll open the serializer PR and feature flag.
infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: cache-credits-service v0.65 -> staging 2026-03-24T03:00Z.
marta: Thanks. Once staging MV lands we'll validate week-over-week stability before broader rollout.
